title: Mr Wallcover | Wallpaper Installer London
_description: The meta description is the fact-sheet sentence in src/data/facts.json.

hero.titleLead: Mr Wallcover is a London specialist wallcovering installer,
hero.lede: Wallcoverings, hung properly. Silk, grasscloth, hand-painted scenics and bespoke murals, by the same small team that measured the wall and will come back once the paper has settled. Brown's Hotel, The OWO and Four Seasons Ten Trinity Square are on the public record. The private houses are not.

proof.title: Two years inside Brown's Hotel, with the guests still in it.
proof.text: Main decorating contractor, 2022–2024. Our own photographs and short films from the rooms, taken as the work went in.

promise: Specialist wallcovering services, from first selection to the final detail.

intro.title: A practice built for rooms that have to stay in use.
intro.text: A hotel floor that cannot close. A flagship that opens on Thursday. A house with a family in it. The work is planned around the people who have to keep using the building, in London and the surrounding areas, and UK-wide for selected projects.

facts.label: Coverage
facts.value: London and the surrounding areas; UK-wide for selected projects

servicesIntro.title: Measured by us. Hung by us. Checked by us six weeks later.
servicesIntro.text: No hand-offs between the person who surveyed the wall, the person who hung it and the person who comes back. That is the whole method.

serviceCards.title: Surveying
serviceCards.text: We measure the wall that will actually be hung, allow for the repeat, and tell you before anyone orders the last roll.

serviceCards.title: Management
serviceCards.text: One project leader on site every day, and a plain weekly conversation about what happens next.

serviceCards.title: Supply
serviceCards.text: Free-issue paper checked against the measure on arrival, or sourced by us, timed to the hang.

serviceCards.title: Installation
serviceCards.text: Silk, grasscloth, fabric walling, contract vinyl, hand-painted scenics, murals and acoustic panels, including paper on joinery where the drawings ask for it.

serviceCards.title: Aftercare
serviceCards.text: We come back once the paper has settled, and the workmanship is guaranteed for twelve months. Included, not extra.

featured.title: The work that is on the record.
featured.text: Brown's Hotel, The OWO, Four Seasons Ten Trinity Square, House of Hackney's showroom and four Calico Wallpaper events. Private clients are not named. Residential work appears only by street or area, with the owner's agreement.

process.title: How a commission runs, and why the faces do not change.

steps.title: Consultation
steps.text: It starts with a conversation about the date, the building and how you need to keep using it. We advise. We also listen.

steps.title: Scope, room by room
steps.text: After the survey we write a scope of works room by room. Once agreed, that document is the job: openings taken out of the measure, pattern repeat and wastage put in, nothing left to interpretation on site.

steps.title: A leader on the ground
steps.text: Every project has one leader on the ground. They answer for the craft, the progress and what you were told to expect.

steps.title: Weekly oversight
steps.text: On a longer commission, senior oversight checks the work each week and agrees the next steps with you in person.

steps.title: The same core team
steps.text: The team you meet on day one is the team that finishes. On a long job they can stay on or near site when the building and the budget allow.

partners.title: Work delivered in partnership with Calico Wallpaper.
partners.text: Calico Wallpaper murals and papers installed for public events and stores in London, each with its own case study.

aftercare.title: The hang is finished when we have been back.
aftercare.text: Four to six weeks after completion, once the paper has settled, we return to look at every seam and edge. For twelve months the workmanship of the hang is guaranteed. Building movement and damp are not, and we say so in writing.
aftercare.label: Read the aftercare

cta.title: Tell us the building, the material and the date.
cta.text: A hotel floor, a house, a shop, or a paper that is already on the wall and needs looking after. Call, write, or send a WhatsApp with a photograph. A short note is enough to start.
cta.textNoPhone: A hotel floor, a house, a shop, or a paper that is already on the wall and needs looking after. Send a note with a photograph if you have one. A short note is enough to start.
